data.name: Hotel Francés
data.address: C. Maestranza 35, Colonia centro, 44100 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
In a Colonial-style building dating from 1610, this old-world hotel is a block from the city center's bustling Plaza de la Liberación square and a 3-minute walk from Catedral de Guadalajara.
Unpretentious rooms with wooden furnishings offer free Wi-Fi and TVs, in addition to ceiling fans. Suites include living rooms, air-conditioning, beamed ceilings and/or whirlpool tubs. Room service is available.
There's a rustic restaurant, and a lobby bar with an ornate chandelier and regular live music. A breakfast buffet is served for a charge; parking is complimentary.
